focus: Wake memories when the world changes
summary: Memory persistence and archive-and-forget are complete. The autonomous web watcher is next.

milestones.title: Connect the tools
milestones.detail: Public repository, live Nimble search, RawTree event write/read, and a running local model.

milestones.title: Teach the memory gate
milestones.detail: The four-state policy passes 8/8 representative cases and rejects malformed observations or model decisions.

milestones.title: Give memories a lifecycle
milestones.detail: SQLite persists every memory class; detailed evidence is archived before dormant context is removed.

milestones.title: Wake when the world changes
milestones.detail: Use scheduled Nimble checks to detect a changed condition without a manual wake button.

milestones.title: Let the agent act again
milestones.detail: Recover historical rationale, combine fresh evidence, reevaluate the provider, and update the shortlist.

milestones.title: Prove it in three minutes
milestones.detail: Measure context reduction, rehearse one complete story, record the video, and submit.

nimble.detail: A real search returned two source URLs.

rawtree.detail: One connection-test event was written and read back.

activity.title: Archive-and-forget lifecycle complete

activity.title: SQLite memory storage complete

activity.title: Development baseline finalized

activity.title: Build observatory is live
